newsitem.title: UK: Two Brent cargoes clocked, one kept - trade.
newsitem.headline: Two Brent cargoes clocked, one kept - trade.

text.p: Two of three Brent cargoes turning wet on Thursday went unclaimed at the five o'clock deadline, traders said.
The cargoes, due to load June 13-15, were clocked to BP and Morgan Stanley. A third was kept voluntarily by Phibro, they said.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
